headline: How Romanian Capital Can Turn the Resources of Mărginimea Sibiului into Economic Security. Details of the Project That Would Secure Romanian Magnesium for Future Industries
summary: A project in Rășinari, Sibiu County, is planned with a €400 million investment and 100% Romanian capital. It aims to produce magnesium for future industries, reducing European reliance on imports.
why: Magnesium is a critical raw material for lightweight and green-transition manufacturing, and European supply has depended heavily on imports.

original_headline: Cum poate transforma capitalul românesc resursele din Mărginimea Sibiului în securitate economică. Detaliile proiectului care ar asigura magneziu românesc pentru industriile viitorului
